description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: Generic LMO 18650 cell
cell.source: Liaw et al. (2003), J. Power Sources, 119-121, 874-882; Jalkanen et al. (2015), Applied Energy 154, 160-172

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Fitted to LMO OCV data from Liaw et al. (2003); spinel LiMn2O4 plateau near 4.0 V

E_a.note: Activation energy for internal resistance, LMO spinel slightly lower than NMC
E_a.source: Ecker et al. (2015), J. Electrochem. Soc., 162(9), A1836-A1848

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient; LMO spinel cathode dOCV/dT ~ -0.18 mV/K (less negative than NMC)
dOCV_dT.source: Forgez et al. (2010), J. Power Sources 195, 2961; Thomas & Newman (2003), J. Electrochem. Soc. 150, A176
